book.subject: 英语
book.edition: 人教版 PEP（三年级起点）

misconceptions.name: y 结尾没改 i 就加 er
misconceptions.why: 记住了“比较级加 er”，没注意辅音字母加 y 结尾的词要先把 y 改成 i。
misconceptions.move: 列一组：heavy—heavier，funny—funnier，happy—happier，让学生自己说出规律。

misconceptions.name: 该加 -er 的词用了 more
misconceptions.why: 汉语“更重”里有个“更”，就想到 more，说成 more heavy；不知道 heavy 加 er 就已经是“更重”。
misconceptions.move: 拍手数音节：heavy 两拍、以 y 结尾，加 er；beautiful 三拍，才用 more。

misconceptions.name: 有 than 却没用比较级
misconceptions.why: 汉语“比我重”里“重”不变形，就照着用 heavy。
misconceptions.move: 看到 than 就停一下：前面的形容词变了没有？taller、heavier。

misconceptions.name: 不规则动词也加 -ed
misconceptions.why: 多数动词的过去式加 -ed，就把 go、see、eat 这些不规则动词也加上 -ed（goed、seed）。
misconceptions.move: 每学一个不规则动词就记成一对：go—went、see—saw、eat—ate，做成卡片随时抽查。

misconceptions.name: 说过去的事动词没变
misconceptions.why: 汉语说过去的事动词不变，只靠“昨天”“上周”表示时间。
misconceptions.move: 圈出时间词 last weekend、yesterday、ago，看到它们就检查动词变成过去式没有。

misconceptions.name: 用了 did，动词还用过去式
misconceptions.why: 知道是过去的事，用了 did 又把动词也变成过去式，过去时标了两次。
misconceptions.move: 告诉学生：过去只标一次——有了 did，动词就回到原形：Did you watch ...?

items.stem: I'm 45 kg. You're 48 kg. You're ____ than me.
right: heavy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，把 y 改成 i 再加 er：heavier。

ladder.q: 补全：I'm 1.5 m. You're 1.6 m. You're ____ (tall) than me.
补全：This film is ____ (funny) than that one.
用英语说：我比我姐姐小两岁。
ladder.a: I'm two years younger than my sister.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：I ____ (see) a film last weekend.
right: last weekend 说的是过去，动词用过去式；
see 是不规则动词：see → saw。

ladder.q: 用英语说：上周末我吃了饺子，还看了电视。
ladder.a: I ate dumplings and watched TV last weekend.

work: Did you watched TV last night?
right: 问句已经用 did 表示过去了，
后面的动词用原形：Did you watch TV last night?

ladder.q: 补全：— Did you clean your room? — Yes, ____ .
变成问句：She washed her clothes.
变成否定句：I saw a film yesterday.
ladder.a: I didn't see a film yesterday.

items.stem: 补全：Last winter, I ____ to Sanya with my family.
right: Last winter 说的是过去，go 的过去式是 went：
I went to Sanya with my family.

ladder.q: 补全：— Where did you go? — I ____ (go) to Beijing.
用英语说：去年夏天我去了新疆，还骑了马。
ladder.a: Last summer I went to Xinjiang and rode a horse.

work: Last summer we went to Hainan.
right: there 本身就是“到那里”，前面不加 to：
went there，就像 go home 一样。

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：I went ____ home at 5 o'clock.
补全（不需要就写 ×）：We went ____ the park yesterday.
— How did you go there? — 我们坐火车去的。用英语回答。

items.stem: Twenty years ago, there ____ no computers in our school.
right: 说过去“有”用 there was / there were；

ladder.q: 补全：There ____ a small library in my old school.
补全：Now there ____ many trees on the playground.
用英语说：以前我家附近没有公园，现在有两个。
ladder.a: There was no park near my home. Now there are two.
